verdicts.text: Terraform is licensed under BUSL-1.1, which is not OSI-approved.
verdicts.evidence: Several 2026 sources agree that Terraform 1.6.0 and later ship under BUSL 1.1, and that the OSI does not approve BUSL. Scalr (Sept 2026): "Terraform releases since 1.6 ship under BSL 1.1, which the OSI does not approve." Wikipedia lists BUSL-1.1 as "OSI approved: No."
verdicts.framing_note: Strictly, BUSL applies only to Terraform 1.6.0 and later. 1.5.7 was the last MPL 2.0 release, and each BUSL release switches to MPL 2.0 four years after it ships, starting around Oct 2027 for 1.6.0. For current Terraform the claim holds.

verdicts.text: Pulumi is governed by Pulumi Corporation.
